Frontend.reason: Tracker Writing Correction now offers an optional deep-analysis mode that clearly costs two daily quota units. Learners can provide the exact task as text or a locally compressed image, receive a compact report tied to explicit prompt requirements and verbatim essay evidence, and see a clear refund message when recognition fails. Prompt images stay in memory for the request and are replaced by recognized text before any local draft or report is saved.

Backend.reason: The companion Lexi branch adds backward-compatible writing submission V4 validation, server-side two-unit metering, multimodal routing and atomic two-unit refunds for failed prompt recognition or unsupported image routes. It stores only quota and request-receipt metadata; the prompt image, essay and report are not persisted in Supabase. Existing V2 and V3 writing submissions remain accepted.

Admin.reason: The companion Lexi Control branch adds purpose-specific writing policy controls for daily quota units, request bytes, output tokens and route selection, plus visible image-capability and refund semantics. Other Words and Tracker policy cards keep their existing behavior.

Deployment.reason: The deep-writing feature and its coordinated Lexi backend and Control changes are intentionally kept on local codex branches for user review. Nothing from this feature has been pushed, migrated or deployed to production.

Verification.reason: Tracker impact, typecheck, lint, all 86 test files with 542 tests and the production build passed; a final six-file writing regression rerun passed 84 tests. The companion Lexi full-stack release gate and V2/V3/V4 cross-repository writing parity passed. Local browser review confirmed text and image prompt modes, two-unit and refund copy, prompt-aware wording, responsive Tracker and Control layouts, and no horizontal overflow without invoking a quota-bearing AI request.
